Description
The 50 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar™ (In Assay) is an excellent choice for gold investors. The Gold Valcambi CombiBar™ is made from .9999 fine gold, the highest purity level for gold bullion. This makes
50 gram gold combibar
an excellent investment for those wanting to own the purest form of gold.
The Gold Valcambi CombiBar™ is a unique product that offers investors flexibility and convenience. It consists of 50 individual 1-gram bars that can be easily separated into smaller units. This means that investors can choose to sell only a portion of their investment rather than having to sell the entire Valcambi combibar. This flexibility benefits those who need to liquidate their assets quickly, allowing them to sell only what they need without breaking apart a larger Valcambi 50×1 bar.
Design of 50 x 1 Gram Gold CombiBar™
Each 1-gram Valcambi suisse combibar is stamped with the Valcambi logo, the weight, and the purity of the gold on the obverse side. The reverse side of the
Valcambi suisse combibar consists of unique serial numbers and product details.
The
50 gram Valcambi gold combibar
is also individually packaged in a tamper-proof assay card with a serial number and a signature from the assayer. This provides an added layer of security and ensures that the 50 gram gold sheet bars are genuine.
Main Highlights of 50 x 1 Gram Valcambi Gold
Contains 1 oz of .9999 pure gold with a weight of 1 gram and a combined weight of 50 grams.
Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
Minted in Switwerland by Valcambi Suisse.
Each CombiBar is individually sealed with an assay card.
Obverse
: Features a single stamped Valcambi logo along with the weight and purity of each bar.
Reverse
: The combination of 50 bars depicts the unique serial number and product details.

Utilizes Valcambi’s patented CombiBar technology.
